title: The Sun to the World: tarot card meanings
description: Tarot card meanings for The Sun, Judgement and The World (XIX to XXI), upright and reversed, with notes on reading the final major arcana cards in a spread.

scenes.headline: The Sun to the World: tarot card meanings
scenes.caption: Major arcana XIX to XXI cover clarity, calling and completion. Here is what each tarot card traditionally means, upright and reversed.
scenes.vo: Major arcana XIX to XXI cover clarity, calling and completion. Here is what each tarot card traditionally means, upright and reversed.

scenes.headline: The Sun
scenes.caption: A child rides a white horse beneath a bright sun, with sunflowers behind a wall. Joy, vitality, clarity, optimism.
scenes.vo: The Sun. A child rides a white horse beneath a bright sun, with sunflowers behind a wall. Joy, vitality, clarity, optimism.

scenes.headline: Judgement
scenes.caption: An angel sounds a trumpet while figures rise from their coffins with arms open. Reflection, reckoning, calling, forgiveness, renewal.
scenes.vo: Judgement. An angel sounds a trumpet while figures rise from their coffins with arms open. Reflection, reckoning, calling, forgiveness, renewal.
